BOSS 0.1.0
  • Reference

    Two‐Stage BOSS Wrapper

    boss.Rd

    Runs the full two‐stage BOSS procedure: 1) Bayesian sequential design via BOSS_modal(), 2) Hessian update at the mode, 3) Essential‐support extraction and initial fill‐in, 4) Greedy fill‐in to a target spacing, 5) Final update of mode, Hessian, GP hyperparameters, and surrogate.

    boss(
  func,
  D,
  alpha = 0.05,
  h = 0.1,
  modal_opts = list(),
  hess_opts = list(),
  essup_opts = list(),
  fillin_opts = list(),
  verbose = 3
)

    Arguments

    func

    The objective function f: [0,1]^D -> R.

    D

    Integer; input dimension.

    alpha

    Numeric in [0,1], significance level (default 0.05) for the chi-squared cutoff. The essential support is defined to capture around 1 - alpha of the posterior mass.

    h

    Numeric; target fill-in distance (default 0.1).

    modal_opts

    List of options for BOSS_modal(). Any of update_step, max_iter, quad, lower, upper, nu, noise_var, modal_iter_check, modal_check_warmup, modal_k.nn, modal_eps, initial_design, delta, optim.n, optim.max.iter, opt.lengthscale.grid, opt.grid.

    hess_opts

    List of options for update_hessian(). Any of method, method.args, tol.

    essup_opts

    List of options for the essential‐support stage: boundary_initial, plus any remaining arguments to compute_fill_in() (e.g. grid_n, boundary_n).

    fillin_opts

    List of options for the greedy fill_in() stage: max_add, grid_n, boundary_n.

    verbose

    Integer 0–3; for progress.

    Value

    A fully‐updated S3 boss object.
